name: Veilwood Diary
summary: Old-growth forest layered with elven roads and druidic groves. Stormwoods only release their logs in lightning. The Veilmother sleeps beneath the deepest grove.

tasks.description: Chop an oak tree in Veilwood.
Set a bird snare and catch a crimson swift.
Kill a moss sprite.
Talk to Ranger Lyris.
Buy a druid staff from Fletcher Tarin.
Enter the elven village.
Pick a moonpetal from the deeper forest.
Kill a timber wolf.
Fletch a shortbow from Veilwood logs.
Catch a bird in the forest.
Speak to every ranger at the sacred grove.
Use the Veilwood vine shortcut (agility 15).
Fletch and string an oak shortbow using Veilwood logs.
Enter the glowcap grotto (exploration).
Complete 1 easy clue step in Veilwood.

easy.reward: Veilwood cape (easy) + emote: whistle birdsong. Diary lamp (easy) granting 2,500 XP to any skill.

tasks.description: Complete the Veilwood Covenant quest.
Chop a maple tree in Veilwood.
Fletch a yew shortbow.
Kill an ent.
Set a box trap and catch a grey chinchompa.
Brew a divination potion using Veilwood ingredients.
Use an elven bow against a shadow panther.
Navigate the sacred grove.
Collect 5 spirit seeds.
Kill a unicorn and harvest its horn.
Use the Lunar Plank Make spell on a Veilwood log.
Participate in a Guardians of the Rift minigame round.
Farm a ranarr herb in the Veilwood patch.
Complete 1 medium clue step in Veilwood.
Discover the elven archive library (exploration).

medium.reward: Veilwood cape (medium) + elven village bank access. Graceful hood (veilwood-elite cloth tier, skilling-outfit piece +4% fletching XP). Diary lamp (medium) granting 7,500 XP to any skill above level 40.
medium.perk_description: Elven village bank teleport; +10% woodcutting XP in Veilwood; sacred grove shortcut; graceful hood (fletching XP outfit bonus).

tasks.description: Complete the Stormwood Rite quest.
Chop a stormwood log during a storm event.
Catch a red chinchompa (hunter 63).
Kill the corrupted Elder Druid.
Fletch a magic shortbow.
Set up and check a yew birdhouse.
Kill a tree spirit.
Use the Lunar Cure Plant spell on a Veilwood farming patch.
Collect 10 moonpetals in one trip.
Kill a dire wolf pack (5 wolves without banking).
Complete a hunter rumour chain (5 consecutive catches).
Complete 3 hard clue steps in Veilwood.
Participate in a Big Chinchompa minigame round.
Fletch 100 yew longbows in a single trip.
Cross the canopy bridge shortcut (agility 68).

hard.reward: Veilwood cape (hard) + storm tree access permit. Diary lamp (hard) granting 15,000 XP to any skill above level 60.
hard.perk_description: Stormwood logs accessible without storm event; +5% chinchompa catch rate; Lunar Cure-Plant 50% cooldown.

tasks.description: Defeat The Veilmother.
Chop a magic tree in Veilwood.
Complete the Lunar Diplomacy quest.
Catch 100 chinchompas in Veilwood.
Complete every Veilwood quest.
Fletch and enchant a stormwood bow.
Complete the Fletcher's Trial quest.
Kill all 3 Veilwood boss-tier creatures.
Harvest 20 herbs from the Veilwood farming patch in one run.
Complete a hard clue step in the sacred grove.
Craft a stormwood longbow (v) from storm-charged logs.
Reach 99 in Fletching via Veilwood resources.
Complete 3 elite clue steps in Veilwood.
Complete a Temple Trekking round via the Veilwood route.
Discover the Veilmother's resting chamber (deep exploration).

elite.reward: Veilwood cape (elite — woven leaf-trim recolour), magic tree shortcut, druidic acorn pendant. Druidic aspect (stat-bonus reward): +50% herblore XP when mixing in the sacred grove (Ardougne Elite analog). Chance at Leafkin pet (1/5000 per Veilwood boss kill after completion). Diary lamp (elite) granting 50,000 XP to any skill above level 75.
elite.perk_description: Magic tree shortcut; unlimited Veilwood teleport; +5% rare drop chance from Veilwood bosses; +50% herblore XP when mixing potions in sacred grove (stat-bonus); Leafkin pet eligibility.
